outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with raw western blot images (IP flow-through/elution), not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts of % HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody show no error bars, indicating single densitometry values from the blots in (A) rather than averages across replicates, so individual points are not required.
Heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Violin plots already display the full distribution of the underlying data, so individual points are not required.
Bar charts show mean ± SD for Htt, F8a1, and Synj1 abundances (n=4) with individual data points overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted molecular structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plots comparing enrichment ratios in Q20 vs Q140; scatter plots inherently show individual data points.
Scatter plot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance across individual IP-MS experiments; individual points are the data itself.
PCA scatter plot where each marker represents an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points.
PCA scatter plots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum) with each marker representing an individual sample; scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
